BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION

 IN   THE   MATTER      OF   THE
 APPLICATION OF EL PASO ELECTRIC
 COMPANY FOR REVISION OF ITS                                Case No. 25-00082-UT
 RETAIL ELECTRIC RATES PURSUANT
 TO ADVICE NOTICE NO. 317


MOTION TO INTERVENE OF THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE
           AND ALL OTHER FEDERAL EXECUTIVE AGENCIES

        The United States Department of Defense and all other Federal Executive Agencies

(“DoD/FEA”), pursuant to 1.2.2.23 NMAC, hereby files this Motion to Intervene in the above

referenced proceeding. DoD/FEA also requests, pursuant to 1.2.2.10(C) NMAC, that it be placed

on the official service list in order for DoD/FEA to receive copies of all documents; discovery

requests and responses; and pleadings and orders filed in this compliance docket. As grounds for

this Motion, DoD/FEA states:

    1. The name, address, and telephone number of the movant and DoD/FEA’s authorized

representative in this matter is:

                                Kyle J. Smith
                                Utility Regulatory Counsel
                                U.S. Department of the Army
                                Office of the General Counsel
                                Environmental Law Division
                                9275 Gunston Road
                                Fort Belvoir, VA 22060-4446
                                Telephone: (703) 693 – 1274
                                Email: kyle.j.smith124.civ@army.mil

        All pleadings and other documents should be served upon DoD/FEA’s authorized

representative. DoD/FEA consents to service by electronic mail to the email address provided

above. DoD/FEA’s counsel has also provided the executed nondisclosure agreement applicable

to this matter as Exhibit “A” to this Motion.



                                            Page 1 of 3
        2.   DoD/FEA’s authorized representative is an attorney licensed in Florida and Washington,

D.C. DoD/FEA’s authorized representative is appearing in this matter pursuant to N.M.A.C.

1.2.2.9 (F)(1). 1

       3. DoD/FEA is an association of federal government executive agencies and departments.

DoD/FEA members for this case include, but are not limited to, United States Department of the

Army, United States Department of the Air Force, White Sands Missile Range, Holloman Air

Force Base, and Fort Bliss.

       4. DoD/FEA is a large customer of El Paso Electric and will be affected by the outcome of

this matter. Therefore, DoD/FEA has a justiciable interest in this matter which may be adversely

affected by the outcome of the proceeding.

       5. DoD/FEA’s intervention is substantially in the public interest and does not present any

undue prejudice to any other party.

       6. The parties have been conferred with on DoD/FEA’s requested intervention and no parties

have indicated opposition to DoD/FEA’s intervention in this matter. El Paso Electric Company,

the City of Law Cruces, Doña Ana County, Western Resource Advocates, Walmart, and the

Coalition for Clean Affordable Energy have all responded with no opposition to this motion.

            WHEREFORE, the United States Department of Defense and all other Federal Executive

Agencies requests that it be granted leave to intervene as a full party in this proceeding, with all

rights attendant to full party status.




1
    40 U.S.C. § 481 has been recodified as 40 U.S.C. § 501 and 40 U.S.C. § 486 has been recodified as 40 U.S.C. § 121.
